draft.emotion: energetic and purposeful, focused on reaching a destination quickly
notes: Note that 走る (hashiru) is almost always used for moving on foot, unlike the English 'run' which can apply to cars or liquids.
Do not confuse this with 駆ける (kakeru), which implies a more nimble, light-footed movement like a horse or a person darting forward.
